# <span id="aanchor304"></span> All Services

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FcSrvAudit">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Audit Service (FcSrvAudit.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FcSrvAudit">

Enables users to automatically monitor check to sales meters and flag for unacceptable user-defined differences - on a spot basis or over a user-defined period. Audits are configured in Meter Editor and utilize a host of user-defined parameters for identifying suspect volume and energy discrepancies.

Audits also generate all the necessary third-party correspondence while tracking each audit’s current and historical status. Provides the foundation for an effective measurement audit group/department.

**Requirements:** Audit Package Module

See: [Audits](../../Tools/Audits.md)

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FcSrvAutoEstimate">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Auto Estimate Service (FcSrvAutoEstimate.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FcSrvAutoEstimate">

Based on the settings with Meter Editor, the service will automatically recognize that data is missing and calculate estimated data for the meter based on historical data from that meter. The estimated data can be automatically replaced with actual data when it becomes available. Auto Estimates will also create data for balance purposes where no actual meter exists.

By default, the Auto Estimate services will start at:

- 12:00 am
- 4:00 am
- 10:00 am
- 12:00 pm
- 6:00 pm

**Requirements:** Service to Auto Estimate Missing Data Module

See: [Meter Editor](../../Meters/Meter%20Editor/Meter%20Editor.md)

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FcSrvAutoRescan">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Auto Rescan Service (FcSrvAutoRescan.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FcSrvAutoRescan">

Scans for missing records and queues SCADA to poll the meter for the missing data

See: [Meter Editor](../../Meters/Meter%20Editor/Meter%20Editor.md)

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FcSrvBatchScheduleMatching">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Batch Schedule Matching Service (FcSrvBatchScheduleMatching.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FcSrvBatchScheduleMatching">

Matches scheduled batches with imported batches

Associates meter batches to the scheduled batch movements defined in the Batch Movement Reconciliation Viewer. Processes Queue entries on the Batch Matching tab of the Service Queues.

**Requirements:** Liquids Add-in

See: [Scheduled Batch Movement](../../Imports/Scheduled%20Batch%20Movement/Scheduled%20Batch%20Movement.md)

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FcSrvCalcMtrRollup">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Calculated Meter Service (FcSrvCalcMtrRollup.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FcSrvCalcMtrRollup">

Calculates hourly, daily, and monthly data for a calculated meter based on member data in final form tables. The resulting data is used in the final form tables and can be seen in the Rollup Viewer. The same final form data is also used in reports and exports.

See: [Calculated Meter Rollup Process](../../Calculated%20Meter%20Editor/Formulas/Calculated%20Meter%20Rollup%20Process.md)

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FlowCal.Archival.Service.exe">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Data Archive Service (FlowCal.Archival.Service.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FlowCal.Archival.Service.exe">

Transfers meter periodic data (FC_METER_PERIODIC_VALUES), final form meter hourly (FC_FFMTR_HOURLY), and final form location hourly (FC_FFLCN_HOURLY) data from production database to an archive database. The service also processes data restore, re-archive, and manual purge operations.

**Requirements:** Data Archive Add-on

See: [Data Archive Solution](../Application/Data%20Archive/Data%20Archive%20Solution.md)

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FcSrvFileImport">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />File Import Service (FcSrvFileImport.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FcSrvFileImport">

Automatically imports a variety of different file formats such as CFX, meter text files, source analysis text files, etc.

Requires the service log on use a network account with elevated privileges, configured in Microsoft’s Services console (refer to the Service Security section).

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FcSrvHCDPQueueProcessor">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />HCDP Service (FcSrvHCDPQueueProcessor.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FcSrvHCDPQueueProcessor">

Calculates the hydrocarbon dew point (HCDP) and cricondentherm (CCT) of a GQ source analysis. The calculation uses the unmodified Peng-Robinson equation of state. Input sample pressure and sample temperature (GQ Source Analysis detail \> Sample tab) must be in units of psi and degrees Fahrenheit, respectively, and results are in degrees Fahrenheit.

Option for HCDP must be enabled within Gas Quality Source Editor.

**Requirements:** Source Analysis Module

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FlowCal.Enterprise.Integration.Service">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />TESTit 3 Integrated FLOWCAL Service (FlowCal.Enterprise.Integration.Service.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FlowCal.Enterprise.Integration.Service">

FLOWCAL service responsible for publishing and handling TESTit Integrated related information; this includes pushing meter and list updates as well as receiving PDF, test point data and meter characteristic information from TESTit v3 to FLOWCAL.

**Requirements:** TESTit v3 Integrated Only

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FlowCal.Enterprise.Integration.List.Polling.Service">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />TESTit 3 Integrated List Service (FlowCal.Enterprise.Integration.List.Polling.Service.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FlowCal.Enterprise.Integration.List.Polling.Service">

FLOWCAL service responsible for polling dynamic list updates for TESTit v3 Integrated and publishing that information, for TESTit enabled lists.

**Requirements:** TESTit v3 Integrated Only

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FlowCal.FieldApplications.Integration.Service">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />TESTit 3 Integrated TESTit Service (FlowCal.FieldApplications.Integration.Service.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FlowCal.FieldApplications.Integration.Service">

TESTit service (starting with TI 3.3) responsible for publishing and handling TESTit Integrated related information. This includes pushing test point data and meter characteristic updates as well as receiving meter and list information from FLOWCAL to TESTit.

**Requirements:** TESTit v3 Integrated Only

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Flowcal.LineFill.Service">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Line Fill Service (Flowcal.LineFill.Service.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Flowcal.LineFill.Service">

Calculates liquid component line fill on a pipe segment. Located in the NGLLineFill subdirectory of the FLOWAL install folder and is a Microsoft .NET service. It must be installed and uninstalled using the \_installService.cmd and \_uninstallService.cmd in the NGLLineFill subdirectory. It cannot be installed or uninstalled like the other FLOWCAL (non-Microsoft .NET) services.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FcSrvListMembersAPI">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />List Members API service (FcSrvListMembersAPI.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FcSrvListMembersAPI">

TESTit 3 Integrated service responsible for obtaining members from a list when purging or exporting a list; also used to manage list synchronization between FLOWCAL and TESTit.

**Requirements:** TESTit V3 Integrated Only

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FlowCal.LiveOil.Service">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Live Oil Service (FlowCal.LiveOil.Service.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FlowCal.LiveOil.Service">

Processes and writes periodic data to dead oil and flash gas meters when they have an active relationship with a live oil meter in FLOWCAL.

**Requirements:** Liquids System and Live Oil Management add-on

See: [Live Oil Management](../../Meters/Meter%20Editor/Tools%20Menu.md) and [Live Oil Service](Live%20Oil%20Service.md)

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FcSrvLcnCloseData">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Location Close Service (FcSrvLcnCloseData.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FcSrvLcnCloseData">

Closes a contract month for a location and tickets associated with the location.

**Requirements:** Monthly Close Functions and Service Module

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FcSrvLcnRollup">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Location Rollup Service (FcSrvLcnRollup.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FcSrvLcnRollup">

Used to calculate hourly, daily, and monthly data for locations from meter data. The resulting data is used in the final form tables and can be seen in the Rollup Viewer. The same final form data is also used in reports and exports. This service also calls for location validations to be performed.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FcSrvLcnRollupStation">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Location Rollup Service (Station Locations) (FcSrvLcnRollupStation.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FcSrvLcnRollupStation">

Ensures that "Station" locations are prioritized to roll up before any other type of location; the standard location rollup service (FcSrvLcnRollup.exe) can be copied and renamed multiple times depending on need; each instance of the service must have a unique name by appending an integer at the end of the name.

</div>

<span id="MeterClose"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FcSrvCloseData">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Meter Close Service (FcSrvCloseData.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FcSrvCloseData">

Closes a contract month for a meter and tickets that have effective dates in the contract month, based on a close schedule.

For any location on the list or the close group on a close schedule, meter and ticket members of the location are closed.

Closing a contract month prevents editing of the meter or ticket data. Subsequent changes to a meter's or ticket's data for the closed contract month will generate a prior period adjustment (PPA).

A child dead oil or flash gas meter will not close if a Live Oil service queue entry exists for the meter.

**Requirements:** Monthly Close Functions

</div>

<span id="MeterRollup"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FcSrvMtrRollup">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Meter Rollup Service (FcSrvMtrRollup.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FcSrvMtrRollup">

Used to calculate hourly, daily, and monthly data for meters from meter periodic values. The resulting data is used in the final form tables and can be seen in the Rollup Viewer. The same final form data is also used in reports and exports.

For Meter Characteristic and Analysis Data meeting a certain criteria, the Meter Rollup service will condense datetime effective records to help maintain database stability and performance. Users can also initiate this process manually for meters using the [FLOWCAL Data Condenser utility](../../Admin%20Options/FcDataCondenser.md).

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="IntegrationEvents">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Quorum Enterprise Integration FLOWCAL Service (FLOWCAL.Integration.Events.Service)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="IntegrationEvents">

Quorum Enterprise Integration (QEI) allows FLOWCAL data to be shared seamlessly with other applications within the Quorum Software ecosystem. This event-driven data sharing sends data to a central Integration Platform, where it can then be sent on to other Quorum applications. Currently, applications that support integration with FLOWCAL are:

- QPTM
- TIPS

FLOWCAL supports sending header information, quantities and sample data for meters and calculated meters.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FcSrvReports">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Report Scheduling Service (FcSrvReports.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FcSrvReports">

Runs reports and exports using report schedules defined by the user. Output can be printed, emailed, or saved to a network location.

Requires the service log on use a network account with elevated privileges, configured in Microsoft’s Services console. Also requires a company email account that will be used to email reports/exports (refer to the Service Security section).

**Requirements:** Scheduled Reporting Module

See: [Configure Report/Export Scheduling](../../Admin%20Options/Configure%20Report-Export%20Scheduling.md)

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FcSrvGqTrans">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Source Apply Service (FcSrvGqTrans.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FcSrvGqTrans">

Applies GQ and LQ source analysis data to meter data and standalone ticket data (data edits and imports will queue a source analysis apply).

**Requirements:** Source Analysis Module

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FcSrvGqAnlRollup">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Source Rollup Service (FcSrvGqAnlRollup.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FcSrvGqAnlRollup">

All source quality samples are stored at the data resolution they are generated (4-minute, hourly, daily, monthly, quarterly, etc.). The quality samples are averaged and rolled up into daily and monthly averages. This could be useful for users handling daily and weekly chromatographs that need to report averages for a period.

When the source quality type is "Chromatograph" or "RTU Average", the quality samples are weight-averaged and rolled up into daily and monthly averages. Sample pressure and pample temperature value are not rolled up for chromatographs. If the type is "Gas Analysis", the quality is copied directly to the rollup tables.

Requires the Enable Rollups option checked within the Gas Quality Source Editor. Feature is not currently supported for Liquid Sources.

**Requirements:** Source Analysis Module

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FcSrvTESTitAnalysisSync">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />TESTit Analysis Sync Service (FcSrvTESTitAnalysisSync.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FcSrvTESTitAnalysisSync">

Sends the current gas meter analysis in FLOWCAL to the corresponding gas analysis database table in TESTit for use in test reports. Meters need to be enabled for TESTit and rolled up for their analysis data to be copied to TESTit. Meter analysis data that is a part of auto estimated records is not copied by this service.

The service is installed in the same manner that any other FLOWCAL service is installed. Once installed, it is started from the Windows Service Monitor and runs at 7:00 AM every day by default.

**Requirements:** TESTit Integrated (2.14.2 and above or 3.3 and above)

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FcSrvTESTitCalAdjApply">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />TESTit Calibration Apply Service (FcSrvTESTitCalAdjApply.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FcSrvTESTitCalAdjApply">

Processes TESTit test reports and applies calibration adjustments if the TESTit imports are configured for Auto Calibration Adjustments.

**Requirements:** TESTit Integrated (v2 and v3)

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FcSrvTESTitExportScheduler">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />TESTit Export Scheduler Service (FcSrvTESTitExportScheduler.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FcSrvTESTitExportScheduler">

Automatically processes scheduled TESTit export jobs via TSX files.

**Requirements:** TESTit v2 Integrated Only

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FcSrvTESTitSchedulerImport">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />TESTit Import Service (FcSrvTESTitSchedulerImport.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FcSrvTESTitSchedulerImport">

Automatically imports TESTit TSX files from a designated file location.

**Requirements:** TESTit v2 Integrated Only

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FcSrvTrans">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Transaction Queue Service (FcSrvTrans.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FcSrvTrans">

Processes import records from the transaction queue tables.

**Requirements:** Online Transaction Processing Module

See: [Transaction Queue](Transaction%20Queue.md)

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FcSrvTransPD">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Transaction Queue Service (Positive Displacement) (FcSrvTransPD.exe)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FcSrvTransPD">

The Transaction Queue service (Positive Displacement) (FcSrvTransPD.exe) is a copy of the standard Transaction Queue service (FcSrvTrans.exe). Its purpose is to only import transactions created by the Import \> Manual Entry \> Positive Displacement data entry screens. The objective is to import PD entry transactions as soon as possible regardless of how long the transaction queue is or whether the PD transactions were created after all waiting transactions.

Transactions created by the PD UIs are written to the FC_TRANSACTION_QUEUE table with a write_timestamp equal to beginning of time (63093600, 1/1/1972 00:00:00:00) and the service will only import transactions whose write_timestamp is equal to beginning of time.

PD entry transaction will also be imported by the standard Transaction Queue service (FcSrvTrans.exe). Since the PD entry transactions are created with the beginning of time write_timestamp, the service will process them before processing standard transactions.

</div>
